player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A yeke na lege ni ape; fa tënë ti mo tongana [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: A lingbi ti hinga so a yeke na popo ti {min_guess} nga na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mgbèlè 0 a zì {guess0}; Mgbèlè 1 a zì {guess1}. Kò si mbênî, Mgbulü a ye: {target}.
message.round_draw: A yeke gï tongana a kiri na ala oko.
message.round_win: Zo so ayeke {winner} awara dengo benda na yâ ti tour ni!

outcome.p0_wins: Zo ti ngia 0 awara gbâ ti angangu.
outcome.p1_wins: Zo ti kozo ni asö benda mingi.
outcome.draw: Na yâ ti ye kue, ala use kue ayeke na kpale.
